testCaseList:
rfsim-5gnr-xn-ho SA TDD Xn Handover wrench
Pull_Local_Registry Pull Images from Local Registry localhost oai-gnb-asan oai-nr-cuup-asan oai-nr-ue-asan
Create_Workspace Create new Workspace localhost
Deploy_Object Deploy OAI 5G CoreNetwork localhost ci-scripts/yaml_files/5g_rfsimulator_xn_ho mysql oai-amf oai-smf oai-upf oai-ext-dn
Deploy_Object Deploy OAI 5G source gNB-0 (CU-CP/CU-UP/DU, PCI 0) + UE RFsim SA localhost ci-scripts/yaml_files/5g_rfsimulator_xn_ho oai-cucp-0 oai-cuup-0 oai-du-0 oai-nr-ue
Attach_UE Attach OAI UE (Wait for IP) rfsim5g_ue localhost
Ping UL ping ext-dn from NR-UE (baseline, on gNB-0) rfsim5g_ue localhost rfsim5g_ext_dn localhost -c 20 -i0.5 80
Ping Ping NR-UE from ext-dn (baseline, on gNB-0) rfsim5g_ext_dn localhost rfsim5g_ue localhost -c 50 -i 0.25 5
Deploy_Object Deploy OAI 5G target gNB-1 (CU-CP/CU-UP/DU, PCI 1) RFsim SA localhost ci-scripts/yaml_files/5g_rfsimulator_xn_ho oai-cucp-1 oai-cuup-1 oai-du-1
IdleSleep Sleep (let gNB-1 come up and the Xn association establish) 10
Custom_Command Trace: Xn Setup between gNB-0 and gNB-1 localhost for i in $(seq 1 20); do docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-0 2>&1 | grep -qE "Xn Setup Response|XnAP.*[Aa]ssociation.*(up|established)|Received XN SETUP RESPONSE" && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1 yes
gNB-1 (PCI 1) -->
Custom_Command HOP 1 - Trigger Xn Handover: gNB-0 -> gNB-1 (target PCI 1) localhost echo ci trigger_xn_ho 1,1 | ncat 192.168.71.150 9090 | grep -E "Xn handover triggered for UE 1 toward target PCI 1" yes
Custom_Command HOP 1 - Trace: XnAP HANDOVER REQUEST sent by source gNB-0 localhost for i in $(seq 1 20); do docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-0 2>&1 | grep -qE "Handover Preparation.*target|Send.*XnAP HANDOVER REQUEST|Sending Xn Handover Request" && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1 yes
Custom_Command HOP 1 - Trace: XnAP HANDOVER REQUEST received by target gNB-1 localhost for i in $(seq 1 20); do docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-1 2>&1 | grep -qE "Received.*Handover Request \(on NR Cell ID|Received XnAP HANDOVER REQUEST" && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1 yes
Custom_Command HOP 1 - Trace: XnAP HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE received by source gNB-0 localhost for i in $(seq 1 20); do docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-0 2>&1 | grep -qE "HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE|Handover Request Acknowledge|HO acknowledged" && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1 yes
Custom_Command HOP 1 - Trace: RRCReconfiguration (HO Command) sent to UE localhost for i in $(seq 1 20); do docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-0 2>&1 | grep -qE "Send reconfiguration \(HO Command\) to UE|Send reconfiguration for UE .* RNTI" && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1 yes
Custom_Command HOP 1 - Trace: XnAP HANDOVER SUCCESS + NGAP PATH SWITCH REQUEST at target gNB-1 localhost for i in $(seq 1 20); do docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-1 2>&1 | grep -qE "HANDOVER SUCCESS|Handover Success" && docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-1 2>&1 | grep -qE "PATH SWITCH REQUEST|Path Switch Request|Triggering NGAP Path Switch" && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1 yes
IdleSleep Sleep 2
Ping HOP 1 - Ping NR-UE from ext-dn (bearer survived HO to gNB-1) rfsim5g_ext_dn localhost rfsim5g_ue localhost -c 50 -i 0.25 5
Ping HOP 1 - Ping ext-dn from NR-UE rfsim5g_ue localhost rfsim5g_ext_dn localhost -c 50 -i 0.25 10
Custom_Command HOP 1 - UE (1) migrated to gNB-1 DU (gNB_DU_ID 1234)? localhost echo ci fetch_du_by_ue_id | ncat 192.168.71.180 9090 | grep "1234" yes
gNB-0 (PCI 0) -->
Custom_Command HOP 2 - Trigger Xn Handover: gNB-1 -> gNB-0 (target PCI 0) localhost echo ci trigger_xn_ho 0,1 | ncat 192.168.71.180 9090 | grep -E "Xn handover triggered for UE 1 toward target PCI 0" yes
Custom_Command HOP 2 - Trace: XnAP HANDOVER REQUEST / ACKNOWLEDGE (gNB-1 -> gNB-0) localhost for i in $(seq 1 20); do docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-1 2>&1 | grep -qE "Handover Preparation.*target|Send.*XnAP HANDOVER REQUEST" && docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-1 2>&1 | grep -qE "HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE|HO acknowledged" && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1 yes
Custom_Command HOP 2 - Trace: RRCReconfiguration (HO Command) + XnAP HANDOVER SUCCESS + NGAP PATH SWITCH localhost for i in $(seq 1 20); do docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-1 2>&1 | grep -qE "Send reconfiguration \(HO Command\) to UE" && docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-0 2>&1 | grep -qE "HANDOVER SUCCESS|Handover Success" && docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-0 2>&1 | grep -qE "PATH SWITCH REQUEST|Triggering NGAP Path Switch" && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1 yes
IdleSleep Sleep 2
Ping HOP 2 - Ping NR-UE from ext-dn (back on gNB-0) rfsim5g_ext_dn localhost rfsim5g_ue localhost -c 50 -i 0.25 5
Ping HOP 2 - Ping ext-dn from NR-UE rfsim5g_ue localhost rfsim5g_ext_dn localhost -c 50 -i 0.25 10
Custom_Command HOP 2 - UE (1) migrated back to gNB-0 DU (gNB_DU_ID 3584 = 0xe00)? localhost echo ci fetch_du_by_ue_id | ncat 192.168.71.150 9090 | grep "3584" yes
Iperf HOP 2 - Iperf (DL/3Mbps/UDP)(20 sec) after 2 handovers -u -b 3M -t 20 -R rfsim5g_ue localhost rfsim5g_ext_dn localhost 5 90
gNB-1 (PCI 1) -->
Custom_Command HOP 3 - Trigger Xn Handover: gNB-0 -> gNB-1 (target PCI 1) localhost echo ci trigger_xn_ho 1,1 | ncat 192.168.71.150 9090 | grep -E "Xn handover triggered for UE 1 toward target PCI 1" yes
Custom_Command HOP 3 - Trace: XnAP HANDOVER REQUEST / ACKNOWLEDGE / HO Command / HANDOVER SUCCESS / PATH SWITCH localhost for i in $(seq 1 20); do docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-0 2>&1 | grep -qE "Handover Preparation.*target" && docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-0 2>&1 | grep -qE "HO acknowledged|HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE" && docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-0 2>&1 | grep -qE "Send reconfiguration \(HO Command\) to UE" && docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-1 2>&1 | grep -qE "HANDOVER SUCCESS|Handover Success" && docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-1 2>&1 | grep -qE "PATH SWITCH REQUEST|Triggering NGAP Path Switch" && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1 yes
IdleSleep Sleep 2
Ping HOP 3 - Ping NR-UE from ext-dn rfsim5g_ext_dn localhost rfsim5g_ue localhost -c 50 -i 0.25 5
Ping HOP 3 - Ping ext-dn from NR-UE rfsim5g_ue localhost rfsim5g_ext_dn localhost -c 50 -i 0.25 10
Custom_Command HOP 3 - UE (1) migrated to gNB-1 DU (gNB_DU_ID 1234)? localhost echo ci fetch_du_by_ue_id | ncat 192.168.71.180 9090 | grep "1234" yes
gNB-0 (PCI 0) -->
Custom_Command HOP 4 - Trigger Xn Handover: gNB-1 -> gNB-0 (target PCI 0) localhost echo ci trigger_xn_ho 0,1 | ncat 192.168.71.180 9090 | grep -E "Xn handover triggered for UE 1 toward target PCI 0" yes
Custom_Command HOP 4 - Trace: XnAP HANDOVER REQUEST / ACKNOWLEDGE / HO Command / HANDOVER SUCCESS / PATH SWITCH localhost for i in $(seq 1 20); do docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-1 2>&1 | grep -qE "Handover Preparation.*target" && docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-1 2>&1 | grep -qE "HO acknowledged|HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE" && docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-1 2>&1 | grep -qE "Send reconfiguration \(HO Command\) to UE" && docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-0 2>&1 | grep -qE "HANDOVER SUCCESS|Handover Success" && docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-0 2>&1 | grep -qE "PATH SWITCH REQUEST|Triggering NGAP Path Switch" && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1 yes
IdleSleep Sleep 2
Ping HOP 4 - Ping NR-UE from ext-dn rfsim5g_ext_dn localhost rfsim5g_ue localhost -c 50 -i 0.25 5
Ping HOP 4 - Ping ext-dn from NR-UE rfsim5g_ue localhost rfsim5g_ext_dn localhost -c 50 -i 0.25 10
Custom_Command HOP 4 - UE (1) migrated back to gNB-0 DU (gNB_DU_ID 3584)? localhost echo ci fetch_du_by_ue_id | ncat 192.168.71.150 9090 | grep "3584" yes
Iperf HOP 4 - Iperf (UL/3Mbps/UDP)(20 sec) after 4 handovers -u -b 3M -t 20 rfsim5g_ue localhost rfsim5g_ext_dn localhost 5 90
gNB-1 (PCI 1) (5th ping-pong hop) -->
Custom_Command HOP 5 - Trigger Xn Handover: gNB-0 -> gNB-1 (target PCI 1) localhost echo ci trigger_xn_ho 1,1 | ncat 192.168.71.150 9090 | grep -E "Xn handover triggered for UE 1 toward target PCI 1" yes
Custom_Command HOP 5 - Trace: XnAP HANDOVER REQUEST / ACKNOWLEDGE / HO Command / HANDOVER SUCCESS / PATH SWITCH localhost for i in $(seq 1 20); do docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-0 2>&1 | grep -qE "Handover Preparation.*target" && docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-0 2>&1 | grep -qE "HO acknowledged|HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE" && docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-0 2>&1 | grep -qE "Send reconfiguration \(HO Command\) to UE" && docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-1 2>&1 | grep -qE "HANDOVER SUCCESS|Handover Success" && docker logs rfsim5g-oai-cucp-1 2>&1 | grep -qE "PATH SWITCH REQUEST|Triggering NGAP Path Switch" && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1 yes
IdleSleep Sleep 2
Ping HOP 5 - Ping NR-UE from ext-dn (final state: gNB-1) rfsim5g_ext_dn localhost rfsim5g_ue localhost -c 50 -i 0.25 5
Ping HOP 5 - Ping ext-dn from NR-UE rfsim5g_ue localhost rfsim5g_ext_dn localhost -c 50 -i 0.25 10
Custom_Command HOP 5 - UE (1) on gNB-1 DU (gNB_DU_ID 1234) after 5 ping-pong handovers? localhost echo ci fetch_du_by_ue_id | ncat 192.168.71.180 9090 | grep "1234" yes
Iperf Final - Iperf (DL/3Mbps/UDP)(20 sec) after 5 handovers -u -b 3M -t 20 -R rfsim5g_ue localhost rfsim5g_ext_dn localhost 5 90
